process_area.title: Service-Quality Assurance Strategy, Standards & Program Design

value_stream.name: Customer Mystery Shopping & Service Quality Assurance Program

fields.Owner: Head of Service Quality / CX (VS-13) / Quality (VS-31)
fields.Participants: CX (VS-13), Store Ops (VS-07), Ecommerce (VS-10), Trade (VS-11), Sales Enablement (VS-124), Strategy (VS-33)
fields.Trigger: Service-quality strategy; competitive pressure; CX review
fields.Volume: Enterprise service-quality assurance program across all customer touchpoints

workflows.name: Service-Quality Assurance Strategy, Scope & Operating Model

Automation Opportunity: - Coverage-vs-touchpoint modeling; randomized-cadence scheduling; link to CX/HR outcomes analytics
Controls: - CTL-668 (ensure controlled execution — Service-Quality Assurance Strategy, Standards & Program Design (PA-146.1).)
- CTL-668: strategy approved (COO/CHRO); scope covers all touchpoints; cadence randomized (W4363)
Cross-references: - links to VS-13 (CX), VS-07 (store), VS-10 (ecommerce), VS-11 (trade), VS-124 (enablement), W4362 (standards), W4363 (methodology)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Scope-mismatch risk**: assuring only in-store while ecommerce/B2B drift; mitigated by full-touchpoint scope
- **Gaming risk**: predictable shop schedule → stores perform only on shop days; mitigated by randomized/variable cadence (W4363)
System Touchpoints: - CX (VS-13); store ops (VS-07); ecommerce (VS-10); trade (VS-11); sales enablement (VS-124); strategy (VS-33)

steps.activity: Service Quality/CX set the assurance strategy — scope (in-store, ecommerce/app, B2B/field, contact center), cadence, in-house vs agency shopper model, and the link to CX/operations/HR outcomes
Service Quality/Ops map the customer journeys & touchpoints to be assured, align to the service standards (W4362), and define coverage (all stores × frequency)
Service Quality document the strategy, obtain approval, and cascade to standards (W4362), methodology (W4363), KPI (W4364), and governance (W4365)

fields.Owner: Service Quality / CX (VS-13) / Store Ops (VS-07) / Sales Enablement (VS-124)
fields.Participants: CX (VS-13), Store Ops (VS-07), Sales Enablement (VS-124), Ecommerce (VS-10), HR (VS-103)

workflows.name: Service Standards, Customer-Journey Touchpoint Definition & Scoring Rubric

Automation Opportunity: - Standards/rubric library; behavior-based scoring templates; standards pushed to associate training (VS-124)
Controls: - CTL-668 (ensure controlled execution — Service-Quality Assurance Strategy, Standards & Program Design (PA-146.1).)
- CTL-668: standards observable & rubric evidence-based; standards communicated & trained; reviewed on change
Cross-references: - links to VS-13 (CX), VS-07 (store), VS-124 (enablement), VS-19.4 (L&D), W4361 (strategy), W4364 (KPI)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Subjectivity risk**: vague/subjective rubric → unreliable scores; mitigated by observable-behavior rubric & evidence
- **Adoption risk**: standards not communicated → associates unaware; mitigated by training & comms
System Touchpoints: - CX (VS-13); store ops (VS-07); sales enablement (VS-124); L&D (VS-19.4); ecommerce (VS-10)

steps.activity: Service Quality/CX define the service standards per journey touchpoint (greeting, needs-discovery, product knowledge, consultative selling, queue/wait, cleanliness, checkout, recovery, omnichannel consistency)
Service Quality build the scoring rubric — measurable observable behaviors, pass/fail or scaled scoring, weighting by impact, and evidence requirements (photo/recording where lawful)
Store Ops/HR communicate standards to associates (VS-124/VS-19.4), embed in training, and review on change

fields.Participants: Service Quality, CX (VS-13), Vendor (VS-34), Store Ops (VS-07), Risk (VS-21.2), Privacy (VS-91)

workflows.name: Mystery Shopping & Service-Audit Program Design & Methodology

Automation Opportunity: - Randomized scenario/store/time assignment; shopper rotation; scenario-script library; evidence-capture app
Controls: - CTL-668: methodology randomized & evidence-based; anti-collusion controls (W4381); piloted before rollout
Cross-references: - links to VS-34 (vendor), VS-21.2 (risk), VS-91 (privacy), VS-13 (CX), W4362 (standards), W4381 (integrity)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Gaming/collusion risk**: predictable methodology → gamed results; mitigated by randomization, rotation, evidence verification (W4381)
- **Validity risk**: weak scenario/evidence → unreliable measurement; mitigated by validated scripts & QC
System Touchpoints: - Service-quality system (W4368); vendor (VS-34); risk (VS-21.2); privacy (VS-91); CX (VS-13)

steps.activity: Service Quality design the methodology — scenario types (purchase, return, complaint, inquiry, B2B quote, omnichannel), shopper profile (segment-realistic), randomized store/time/associate coverage, and frequency
Service Quality/Vendor build the scenario scripts & evidence-capture protocol (what to observe, evidence type, lawfulness per W4367), and the data-validation/quality-control steps

steps.a: Head of Service Quality / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Service Quality/Risk define anti-gaming/anti-collusion controls (variable timing, shopper rotation, no-notice, evidence verification W4381) and pilot before rollout

fields.Participants: CX (VS-13), Store Ops (VS-07), Strategy (VS-33), HR (VS-103), Finance (VS-17.4)

Automation Opportunity: - Impact-weighted KPI modeling; target calibration to CX/benchmark; KPI-to-incentive auto-link
Controls: - CTL-668 (ensure controlled execution — Service-Quality Assurance Strategy, Standards & Program Design (PA-146.1).)
- CTL-668: KPI impact-weighted; targets calibrated to baseline/benchmark/CX; linked to recognition (W4379)
Cross-references: - links to VS-13 (CX), VS-07 (store), VS-33 (strategy), VS-103 (HR), W4362 (standards), W4379 (recognition)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mis-weighting risk**: KPI weighted to low-impact behaviors → distorted effort; mitigated by impact-based weighting
- **Target-misalignment risk**: targets detached from CX/business outcomes; mitigated by calibration to CX/loyalty data (VS-13)
System Touchpoints: - CX (VS-13); store ops (VS-07); strategy (VS-33); HR (VS-103); finance (VS-17.4); BI (VS-28)

steps.activity: Service Quality/Strategy define the KPI set — overall service score, touchpoint sub-scores, critical-failure rate, recovery effectiveness, omnichannel consistency — and the weighting by business impact
Service Quality/Ops set targets per store/region/touchpoint, calibrate to baseline & benchmark, and define performance tiers
HR/Finance link KPI outcomes to recognition/incentive (W4379) and to operations/CX improvement (W4377), and tune on performance data

fields.Participants: Audit (VS-21), Ethics (VS-119), Legal (VS-100.3), HR (VS-84), Risk (VS-21.2), CX (VS-13)

Automation Opportunity: - Conflict-of-interest declaration tracking; integrity-control monitoring; due-process/dispute workflow (W4380)
Controls: - CTL-668: program independent of measured ops; ethics/fairness framework; due-process (W4380); integrity audited (W4381)
Cross-references: - links to VS-21 (audit), VS-119 (ethics), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-84 (labor), VS-21.2 (risk), W4380 (dispute), W4381 (integrity)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Independence risk**: program influenced by measured operations → biased results; mitigated by independent reporting line & objective vendor selection
- **Entrapment/fairness risk**: scenarios entrap associates or findings unfair → grievance/demotivation; mitigated by ethics framework & due-process (W4380)
System Touchpoints: - Audit (VS-21); ethics (VS-119); legal (VS-100.3); labor relations (VS-84); risk (VS-21.2)

steps.activity: Service Quality/Audit establish program independence — reporting line independent of measured operations, objective shopper/vendor selection, and no conflict of interest
Service Quality/Ethics/Legal set the ethics framework — fairness to associates (no entrapment, proportionate, due-process/dispute W4380), shopper conduct code, and anti-retaliation for findings

steps.a: Audit Lead / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Audit/Risk govern the program — periodic methodology audit, integrity controls (W4381), and escalation of serious/critical findings to leadership (W4383)

fields.Participants: Procurement (VS-34), Legal (VS-100.3), Service Quality, Finance (VS-17.4), Privacy (VS-91), Risk (VS-21.2)

Automation Opportunity: - Agency SLA dashboard; integrity-verification workflow; privacy-compliance tracking; performance scorecard
Controls: - CTL-668 (ensure controlled execution — Service-Quality Assurance Strategy, Standards & Program Design (PA-146.1).)
- CTL-668: agency selected on integrity; SLA-governed; privacy-compliant (W4367); integrity-audited (W4381)
Cross-references: - links to VS-34 (procurement), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-91 (privacy), VS-21.2 (risk), W4367 (privacy), W4381 (integrity)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Agency-integrity risk**: agency fabricates/gamed shops → unreliable data; mitigated by integrity SLA & verification (W4381)
- **Data-privacy risk**: agency mishandles shopper/customer PII; mitigated by privacy terms & audit (VS-91/W4367)
Time Estimate: - ~3–4 weeks per contract cycle; ongoing governance

steps.activity: Procurement/Service Quality source & select a mystery-shop agency (coverage, shopper pool quality, methodology, technology, integrity, references), and contract with SLA, data/privacy terms, and audit rights
Service Quality govern day-to-day agency performance vs SLA (coverage, on-time, evidence quality, data validity), and conduct periodic reviews

steps.a: CFO / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Finance/Risk/Privacy audit agency cost, data-privacy compliance (W4367), integrity (W4381), and enforce consequence/breach

fields.Participants: Privacy/DPO (VS-91), Legal (VS-100.3), Service Quality, Vendor (VS-34), Compliance (VS-22), HR (VS-84)
fields.Trigger: Program operation; privacy review; regulatory change

workflows.name: Service-Quality Compliance, RA 10173 Consent & Data Privacy

Automation Opportunity: - Lawful-evidence capture app with consent prompts; PII minimization/auto-redaction; DSAR workflow; privacy-audit
Controls: - CTL-668: evidence captured within RA 10173 limits; PII minimized/secured; due-process (W4380); privacy-audited
Cross-references: - links to VS-91 (privacy), VS-88 (records), VS-22 (compliance), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-84 (labor), VS-91.3 (breach), W4380 (dispute)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Privacy-violation risk**: unlawful shopper recording → RA 10173/NPC exposure; mitigated by lawful-basis determination & evidence limits
- **Labor-lawfulness risk**: findings used unfairly in discipline → labor grievance; mitigated by due-process (W4380) & legal review
System Touchpoints: - Privacy/DPO (VS-91); records (VS-88); compliance (VS-22); legal (VS-100.3); labor (VS-84); breach (VS-91.3)

steps.activity: DPO/Legal determine the lawful basis & limits for shopper evidence (audio/photo/video) per RA 10173 — where one-party/two-party consent applies, CCTV reliance, PII minimization, associate-fairness
Service Quality/Vendor capture evidence within the lawful limits, minimize/secure PII, retain per policy (VS-88), and handle DSAR access (VS-91)
DPO/Compliance audit privacy compliance, manage any breach (VS-91.3), and ensure labor-lawfulness of findings use (VS-84)

fields.Participants: IT (VS-27), EA (VS-113), BI/Data (VS-28), CX (VS-13), Privacy (VS-91), HR (VS-103)

Automation Opportunity: - Integrated service-quality platform; CX/HR/store auto-link; privacy-by-design evidence store; analytics dashboard
Controls: - CTL-668 (ensure controlled execution — Service-Quality Assurance Strategy, Standards & Program Design (PA-146.1).)
- CTL-668: architecture security-assessed (VS-27.3); PII secured (VS-91/W4367); cost governed (VS-135)
Cross-references: - links to VS-27 (IT), VS-113 (EA), VS-28 (BI), VS-13 (CX), VS-103 (HR), VS-91 (privacy), W4367 (privacy), W4382 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-gap risk**: shop data not linked to CX/HR/store → siloed; mitigated by end-to-end integration
- **Privacy risk**: evidence/PII exposure; mitigated by privacy-by-design (VS-91/W4367)
System Touchpoints: - IT (VS-27); EA (VS-113); BI (VS-28); CX (VS-13); HR (VS-103); privacy (VS-91); security (VS-27.3); TBM (VS-135)

steps.activity: Service Quality/EA/IT design the service-quality data architecture — shop/audit records, scoring, evidence store, and integration to CX (VS-13), store-ops (VS-07), HR (VS-103), BI (VS-28)
IT/BI implement & integrate, govern evidence/PII privacy (W4367), and govern data quality/validation (W4375)
Service Quality/IT govern the platform lifecycle (roadmap, adoption, TBM cost VS-135, security VS-27.3), and optimize on analytics (W4382)
